method: Independent source, focused test and saved installation-evidence review; no new test, provider or production call by this reviewer.

resolvedFinding.problem: A typed local input-budget rejection before the second provider dispatch could lose the already measured first request usage.
resolvedFinding.resolution: The exact typed pre-dispatch rejection now retains measured first usage and a sensory validation marker. Unmeasured or missing second-request usage remains uncertain; no broad provider-exception conversion or replay.
resolvedFinding.coveredBy: Final eight-case model retest, including typed continuation budget rejection and lost usage.

checks: At most one optional semantic lookup through the existing private recall port; no household or passive callback and no additional memory store.
Current principal, owner authorization, foreground, attention and exact claim are checked around lookup and before decision commit.
Query is bounded to 1024 UTF-8 bytes; the actual host-produced context is bounded to 8192 bytes and preserves source hashes and observation time. Model-supplied context cannot replace it.
Only the existing search and final decision tools are exposed. The continuation forces a final decision; both measured requests are aggregated.
A changed private capability profile permits a normal opportunity without bypassing unresolved usage, active work, pending attention or source/window deduplication.
Context persists through private-contact suppression and cooldown handling. Search grants no execution or communication authority and requires no topic or message.

runs.scope: Postgres new and relevant existing cases

validation.overlap: Runs overlap and are not summed into a unique total. These are deterministic focused checks, not ordinary household acceptance.

installationReview.basis: Saved candidate source maps, role overlays, parity metadata and installation receipts; no fresh runtime query by reviewer.
installationReview.changedNodeCheck: Role-specific changed AST nodes match the reviewed checkout changes; removing the single new runtime composition keyword restores each role-specific prior runtime AST.
installationReview.preservation: Other role-specific changes are preserved. Core and worker are not claimed byte-identical. No speech implementation or configuration review is claimed.

limits: GO covers this source/context contract and its recorded installed connection only.
A useful ordinary self-chosen action, checked result and later unprompted reuse remain to be observed.
Daily autonomy, learning and household acceptance are not established; E5.1 remains open.

ordinaryObservationAddenda.scope: Exact ordinary private orientation window 497878; saved events only.
ordinaryObservationAddenda.origin: Coordinator records an ordinary post-startup scheduler cycle, with no manually queued task; inspected event sequence contains observed, claimed, model-started and decided events only.
ordinaryObservationAddenda.interpretation: The offered search was optional and was not used. This observation supplies no useful self-chosen initiative or later followthrough proof. It does not by itself establish a new implementation defect or justify repeated prompt variants.
ordinaryObservationAddenda.independentContentReview: The separate interface reviewer reports correct use of the existing source, result and feedback. This addendum verifies structural events and usage, without publishing or independently re-scoring private text.
